hazards.evidence: White raised toilet seat/safety frame on a white toilet against a white wall and light tile floor, creating very low contrast that is hard for a person with dementia to distinguish.
Large solid dark navy bath mat on the light tile floor in front of the tub/toilet, which can be misperceived as a hole and is also a loose mat on a hard bathroom floor.
